title: What does = actually ask?
hook: 8 + 4 = □ + 5 looks like a sum with a gap in it. What fills the gap?

knows: the equals sign from school sums
doesNotKnow: that "=" says the two sides are the same amount, not "the answer comes next"

misconception: "=" is an instruction to write the answer, so in 8 + 4 = □ + 5 the box is 12 (the sum so far) or 17 (all the numbers added).
objective: The learner can say that 8 + 4 = □ + 5 needs 7 in the box, because "=" says both sides are the same amount, like a level beam.

claims.text: 8 + 4 = 12 and 7 + 5 = 12, so 8 + 4 = 7 + 5: with 7 in the box both sides are 12 and the beam is level.
claims.source: Arithmetic; company/domains/briefs/checks/math-wave-j-check.mjs label A1 ([7, 12, 12, true]). Stage: LEFT = 8 + 4, right = box + 5 in Demo.tsx.
claims.note: Arithmetic: 8 + 4 = 12 = 7 + 5; check A1 re-run. Beam: diff 0 at box = 7, so it is level. artifacts/fact-check-wave-j/wj-econ-phys-math-geo/math.mjs.

claims.text: With 12 or 17 in the box the right side is 17 or 22, not 12, so the beam tips to the right.
claims.source: Arithmetic; check A1 ([12, 12, 17, false], [17, 12, 22, false]). The reveal quotes the first wrong value the learner tried (recorded when the 'tipped' milestone fires) and that value + 5.
claims.note: Arithmetic: 12 + 5 = 17, 17 + 5 = 22. angle = sign(diff) x min(10, 2|diff|) > 0, which rotates the beam clockwise, so the right pan goes down ('tips to the right'). The reveal quotes the first wrong value tried.

claims.text: The equals sign says both sides are the same amount (a = b states that a and b are the same number), not that the answer comes next.
claims.source: The meaning of equality in arithmetic and algebra (a = b means a and b name the same number).
claims.note: Definition of equality (a = b: both sides name the same number). The recall ('box + 3 = 6 + 4' gives 7) also checks out.

recall.question: □ + 3 = 6 + 4. What number goes in the box?
recall.why: The right side is 10, and "=" says both sides are the same amount, so □ + 3 must be 10: the box is 7.
